title: Ikhnos self
description: What running Ikhnos costs and whether it is healthy: the server process (memory, CPU, goroutines, garbage collection, agents connected, flow received) and the agent of each cluster, by cluster name. Written by the Ikhnos server into FUSION every minute; it replaces the System health page.

list.label: Cluster

query.query: query_result((max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (ikhnos_agent_self_rss_bytes)) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (ikhnos_agent_self_rss_bytes)), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)"))

panels.title: The server: is it healthy now
Server series
panels.description: Whether the server is writing its own figures into FUSION. They are written every minute; a figure older than five minutes is gone from Prometheus. Not arriving means the server has no FUSION to write to, FUSION's metrics store is down, or this is not the organisation FUSION belongs to - every other panel here is then empty or old.

panels.title: Agents connected
panels.description: Agents with an open stream to the server right now (the organisation FUSION belongs to). Zero is orange: no cluster can send configuration or be seen live.

panels.title: Server memory
panels.description: Resident memory of the server process. The colour steps are guides, not limits Ikhnos enforces.

panels.title: Server CPU
panels.description: CPU the server process used since its previous sample (every 30 s), in percent of one CPU; above 100 it is using more than one core. The colour steps are guides, not limits Ikhnos enforces.

panels.title: Model cache hits
panels.description: Share of requests for the effective model that were served from the short-lived cache rather than rebuilt. A low share means the server rebuilds the model on most requests. No data means no request in the last interval, which is not a miss.

panels.title: GC pause
panels.description: Milliseconds in every second the Go garbage collector stopped the server (10 ms is 1 %). The colour steps are guides, not limits Ikhnos enforces.

panels.title: Agents reporting
panels.description: Clusters whose agent has sent its figures to the server in the last few minutes (the chosen clusters). Fewer than the clusters Ikhnos knows means an agent is disconnected; the delivery health dashboard says whether its telemetry is arriving.

panels.title: Agent figures
panels.description: How old the newest agent figure is. Agents report with their heartbeat, every 30 seconds.

panels.title: Largest agent
panels.description: Resident memory of the agent that uses the most. The colour steps are guides, not limits Ikhnos enforces.

panels.title: Busiest agent CPU
panels.description: CPU of the agent that uses the most, in percent of one CPU. The colour steps are guides, not limits Ikhnos enforces.

panels.title: Highest share of traffic
panels.description: The largest share of a cluster's observed network throughput that is its agent's own traffic to the server. Absent while no flow collector reports the cluster's throughput.

panels.title: Power seen by agents
panels.description: Power draw of the nodes that report it (RAPL), summed over the chosen clusters. Most nodes do not report it, and then there is no data rather than zero.

panels.title: Agents by cluster

targets.expr: (max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (ikhnos_agent_self_rss_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"})) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (ikhnos_agent_self_rss_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: Every connected cluster's agent, by cluster name: what it costs the cluster (memory, CPU, goroutines), how much of the cluster's traffic it is, the power the cluster's nodes report, and how often it sends flows and runs probes. The newest figure of each; the graphs below show how it moved.

panels.title: Server memory
panels.description: Resident memory of the server process. A steady climb that never comes back down is a leak; a sawtooth is the garbage collector doing its job.

panels.title: Server goroutines
panels.description: Goroutines of the server process: roughly one for each open agent stream and each request in flight, plus a fixed set. A count that climbs without bound is a goroutine leak.

panels.title: Server CPU
panels.description: CPU the server process used, in percent of one CPU, between its samples taken every 30 seconds.

panels.title: Garbage collector pauses
panels.description: Milliseconds in every second the Go garbage collector stopped the whole server. It is the cost of memory pressure that every request pays together.

panels.title: Agents connected
panels.description: Agents with an open stream to the server. A drop is a cluster lost (or a server restart that every agent has to reconnect after); each change is marked in orange.

panels.title: Flow received from agents
panels.description: Bytes per second of flow reports the server receives from all its agents, as they are on the wire. It is the load that the flow interval of each agent puts on the server.

panels.title: Model cache hit rate
panels.description: Share of requests for the effective model served from the cache. A gap is an interval with no request at all, which is neither a hit nor a miss.

panels.title: The agents over time: each cluster by its name

panels.title: Share of the cluster's traffic

targets.expr: (max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (ikhnos_agent_self_bandwidth_share_percent{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"})) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (ikhnos_agent_self_bandwidth_share_percent{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: The share of a cluster's observed network throughput that is its agent's own traffic to the server. It is a share of the whole (the agent's bytes are among the ones counted), not an addition to it. A cluster with no flow collector has no figure.

panels.title: Power seen in each cluster

panels.description: Power draw of the nodes of each cluster that report it (RAPL), summed. Clusters whose nodes do not report it have no line.
